evidence: bare_number_card: seg3:mid and seg3:end show two plain circles labelled 41 and 26 on an empty dark ground. It is a number on a blob, and the cow-to-human jump the title promises is never shown.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start shows '41' and '26' as tiny text on a near-empty frame. By seg3:end they are two plain circles (yellow 41, grey 26) with 'Dairy cow exposure' and 'Poultry exposure' captions, and Data is just standing on top of the 41 circle.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The story's key claim (the virus jumped species: 41 of 70 human cases came from cows, not birds) fell back to a generic two-bubble comparison. Nothing in the picture is made of cows, birds or people, the total of 70 never appears, and the mascot has no act.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the 70 human cases as 70 small person figures, with the 41 linked to a cow and the 26 to a bird. Data should drive the transfer (for example, leading infection lines from a cow to the people one by one) so the viewer sees most cases coming from cows without reading a label. Fill the frame and keep every number clear of the mascot.
